meaning: to take in, absorb knowledge or information

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for taking in liquid, energy, or information, and for organizational incorporation or assimilation.

exampleSentences.english: I need time to absorb this information.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我需要時間吸收呢啲資料。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 kap1 sau1 ni1 di1 zi1 liu2

english.note: Use 吸收 as the all-purpose verb for taking nutrients into the body or taking in information.

exampleSentences.english: After reading the book, I need time to assimilate the new knowledge.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我睇完本書，要慢慢吸收啲新知識。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 jyun4 bun2 syu1 jiu3 maan6 maan6 kap1 sau1 di1 san1 zi1 sik1

english.note: Use this for taking in and absorbing information or media content rather than physically eating it.

exampleSentences.english: I consume a lot of information from the news every day.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我每日睇新聞，吸收好多資訊。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 tai2 san1 man4 kap1 sau1 hou2 do1 zi1 seon3
